body: cc @chuckjaz this is coming from one of the contributors for material
This appears to be the same issue.
Thanks for reporting this issue. However this issue is a duplicate of an existing issue #15192. Please subscribe to that issue for future updates.
@chuckjaz I asked @DevVersion to file this because he still encountered the issue after using the snapshot with the aforementioned fix.

Yeah, in #15192, the `metadata.json` files were not created on Windows. 

And after using `tsc-wrapped-builds` with SHA https://github.com/angular/tsc-wrapped-builds/commit/6298778b57f40c892b6dc87742dad49e45627b64,  the `metadata.json` files are now emitted.

The problem is, that those `metadata.json` files don't have any data included in the `{ metadata: EMPTY }` JSON.

I might be doing something wrong, but I specifically patched the `node_modules` with the `tsc-wrapped` version of `master`. ([see here](https://github.com/DevVersion/ng-compiler-cli-test/blob/master/package.json) & [here](https://github.com/DevVersion/ng-compiler-cli-test/blob/master/inject-tsc-wrapped.sh))

It doesn't feel like #15192 is the same issue. #15192 is only about the files not being emitted.
Reopening issue as the fix for #15192 does not appear to fix this issue.
